title: NexSolve Production & Candidate ML Feature Schemas
description: Defines production 7-feature schema, approved experimental candidate feature set, and excluded features.

experimental_candidate_features.provenance: NASA NASADEM / SRTM1 30m via USGS / AWS Open Data Skadi Archive
Compass direction from Sobel gradient on NASADEM 30m (-1.0 = flat terrain sentinel)
5-point discrete Laplacian profile curvature on NASADEM 30m
DEM tile validity tier (valid / nodata / unavailable)
Mean slope across valid DEM samples inside official Survey of India district boundary
90th percentile slope inside official Survey of India district boundary
Temporally-filtered GSI inventory event count (event_year <= prediction_year, target excluded)
Temporally-filtered GSI event density per sqkm in official district

excluded_features.explanation: Temporal contrast sampling selects control samples at identical location coordinates as historical positive events, rendering distance to nearest inventory event constant (0.0 km).
Simulated soil moisture proxy used strictly in frontend/backend district UI fallbacks; prohibited from ML candidate set.
